description:
Set amidst the tranquil countryside of Killurin, Co. Wexford, this exceptional four-bedroom detached residence presents a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial and beautifully appointed family home, set on approximately 0.6 acre of mature, private and meticulously landscaped grounds. From the moment you approach, the property conveys an immediate sense of peace, privacy and understated elegance. Mature planting, established lawns and carefully considered landscaping create an exceptionally attractive setting, while the generous grounds provide an ideal environment for outdoor living, relaxation and entertaining. The property is further enhanced by a substantial detached block-built garage, providing excellent additional space for secure storage, hobbies, a workshop or practical family requirements. Internally, the house combines generous proportions with a superb standard of presentation and a wealth of high-end finishes throughout.
Every aspect has been thoughtfully considered to create a home that is both luxurious and highly functional, with quality evident throughout the accommodation.

At the heart of the home is the impressive kitchen, dining and living space, creating a wonderful open and sociable environment for everyday family life and entertaining. A recently installed bespoke, handcrafted kitchen forms the centrepiece of this exceptional space, featuring beautiful fitted cabinetry and a high-quality finish. The utility room continues the same elegant design, with fitted units providing a seamless and practical extension of the kitchen. The living area is further enhanced by a stove which forms the true hub of the home, creating a warm and inviting focal point. The combination of the beautifully crafted kitchen, generous dining area and comfortable living space creates an exceptional setting for everything from relaxed family evenings to larger-scale entertaining. Large windows throughout the property allow natural light to flow generously through the accommodation, complementing the attractive outlook over the mature grounds. The overall proportions of the house provide considerable flexibility for modern family living, entertaining and working from home. The four spacious bedrooms offer excellent accommodation, with two bedrooms enjoying the added luxury of private dressing rooms and en-suite facilities. These beautifully considered spaces provide an exceptional level of comfort, privacy and convenience.
The rear of the property features a substantial paved patio, perfectly positioned for al fresco dining, entertaining guests or simply enjoying the serenity of the surrounding gardens. To the side, a private decking area provides an additional outdoor retreat, ideal for morning coffee, evening drinks or relaxing while taking in the peaceful rural surroundings and capturing some river views.
A particularly appealing feature of this residence is its exceptional combination of rural tranquillity, privacy and accessibility. Although enjoying an idyllic countryside setting, the property remains within easy reach of Wexford Town and benefits from excellent road connections to the N25 and the wider South East. For those who travel regularly, Rosslare Europort is readily accessible, offering convenient connections to the UK and mainland Europe and further enhancing the property’s appeal as a prestigious yet practical country residence. The surrounding area is rich in heritage, culture and recreation. Within easy driving distance are the Irish National Heritage Park at Ferrycarrig, historic Wexford Town and the magnificent Johnstown Castle, while the beautiful beaches and coastal attractions of south Wexford are also within easy reach. Whether enjoyed as a permanent family residence, an impressive country retreat or a home designed for entertaining,
this outstanding property offers a wonderful lifestyle opportunity. Combining approximately 0.6 acre of beautifully landscaped private grounds, exceptional privacy, a detached block-built garage, substantial outdoor entertaining areas, a recently installed bespoke handcrafted kitchen, beautifully fitted utility accommodation and a wealth of high-end finishes throughout, this is a truly special home in a highly desirable rural setting. With its generous proportions, luxurious finishes and exceptional attention to detail, this is a home that successfully combines the warmth and comfort of family living with the elegance of a truly distinctive country residence. The sale of this property presents a superb opportunity to acquire a superb home in a convenient countryside
location. Viewing of this stunning home is highly recommended .
